verdict.rationale: Gitea is self-hosted OSS storing repos as standard git data, which is inherently portable (clone-out), giving baseline openness, but there is no documented 'export all data' feature covering issues, PRs, wiki, or org metadata in the evidence pack, and community feedback specifically flags backup/restore as weak, which undercuts confidence in a clean full-data exit. missing for 10: explicit data-export/backup tooling documentation, evidence of exporting issues/PR history/wiki in open formats, and independent confirmation that migrating data OUT of Gitea works smoothly.
